default_semantics.is_default_meta_feature: The feature named `default` is Cargo's default meta-feature key. It is enabled by Cargo default behavior when default-features are not disabled. It is NOT a member of its own expansion list.
default_semantics.default_expansion_member: A non-meta feature listed in the `default` expansion array. These are enabled when the crate default meta-feature is enabled.
default_semantics.in_default_set: Alias of default_expansion_member only (false for the meta-feature itself).
default_semantics.enabled_when_using_crate_defaults: True for the meta-feature and for every default expansion member.

p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.title: Typed server-side room-message search via Client::send
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.summary: No dedicated stable high-level Room message search API. Public residual path is Ruma search_events::v3::Request/Response through Client::send. Pagination: Request.next_batch. Filters/limits: Criteria.filter (RoomEventFilter::limit/rooms) plus keys/order_by/event_context.
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.limits: Compile-only typed API shape. Does not prove homeserver /search behavior or UI.

p0_1_linkage.notes: useMessageSearch.ts is the real Matrix message-search consumer; Login.tsx is inventory-tagged searches but is not representative of room message search and is excluded.

p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.title: experimental-search local message index
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.summary: experimental-search enables local Tantivy-backed index (message_search + search_index), not server /search. Persistence via SearchIndexStoreKind.
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.local_vs_server: local indexing only; distinct from SC-071
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.persistence_implications: Separate on-disk index state from Matrix sqlite stores.
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.synara_selection: Do not select for Phase 1 minimum; prefer SC-071 typed server search.
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.limits: Compile-only experimental API shape. No index open.

p0_1_linkage.notes: Local-index experimental path is an alternative search implementation for the same product search need.

p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.title: experimental-widgets Element Call / widget surface
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.summary: experimental-widgets exposes WidgetDriver/Handle, WidgetSettings, Capabilities, Virtual Element Call URL helpers. Module existence is not product call parity.
sdk_owns: Capability filters including delayed events and to-device filters usable for encryption_keys types
synara_still_needs: Membership write product flow and encryption-key policy beyond capability plumbing
AV devices, ring UX, risk-gate acceptance
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.blocking_risk: Unresolved Element Call/widget product parity remains a blocking risk.
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.limits: Compile-only experimental API shape. No webview/runtime call.

p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.title: sqlite-gated ClientBuilder store surface
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.summary: Feature sqlite enables sqlite_store builders for state/event-cache/media; with e2e-encryption also crypto store.
p0_3b_deferral_resolutions.limits: Compile-only builder API. No database open, no passphrase use.

p0_1_linkage.notes: initMatrix carries indexeddb_matrix_stores; ActionUIA shares uia_auth.

additional_gap_rows.summary: Stable MatrixAuth::get_sso_login_url, login_with_sso_callback, login_token; OAuth::finish_login; MatrixAuth/Client/OAuth refresh_access_token. Feature sso-login only gates local-server login_sso (not asserted here).
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Runtime callback URL handling in Tauri, session persistence, refresh scheduling.

additional_gap_rows.summary: UIA appears as ruma uiaa::AuthData on sensitive APIs (Client::delete_devices). Custom login entry: MatrixAuth::login_custom. Full stage machine semantics remain product work.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Full interactive auth stage UI mapping for all server-offered flows.

additional_gap_rows.summary: Client::rename_device and Client::delete_devices (UIA) are public stable methods.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Device list UX; current-device rename policy; UIA UX.

additional_gap_rows.summary: VerificationRequest::{accept,cancel,start_sas}; SasVerification::{accept,confirm}; Device::request_verification; Encryption::get_verification_request. No dedicated push inbox stream API.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Incoming request discovery UX, emoji/decimal presentation, QR optional path.

additional_gap_rows.summary: Recovery::{enable,recover}; Backups::create under encryption (e2e-encryption). Lifecycle is broader than these entry points.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Full recovery UX, backup steady-state, secret storage, reset with UIA.

additional_gap_rows.summary: No high-level Room delayed-event API outside experimental widgets. Residual stable route: Ruma delayed_message_event::unstable via Client::send.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Product scheduling UX; homeserver MSC4140 support verification.

additional_gap_rows.summary: No dedicated poll service. Probed: Room::send with AnyMessageLikeEventContent, UnstablePollStartEventContent, EditedContent::PollStart, matrix_sdk_ui::timeline::PollState. End-to-end poll UX/runtime not proven.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Composer poll UX; response/end events; aggregation semantics in product UI.

additional_gap_rows.summary: Room::send_raw, Room::send_state_event_raw, Account::account_data_raw, Account::set_account_data_raw are public stable.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Map Synara custom event contracts to DTOs; avoid leaking Raw across IPC.

additional_gap_rows.topic: Room read markers and marked-unread state
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Parity with desktop unread algorithm; live multi-client tests.

additional_gap_rows.summary: Room::has_active_room_call (via BaseRoom Deref) exposes active room-call membership presence. Does NOT provide membership writes, join/leave, or encryption-key exchange.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Product UI for live membership display; write path separate.

additional_gap_rows.summary: Client::rtc_foci returns well-known RTC foci transports. Does not implement call join or key exchange.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Wire foci into call frontend selection.

additional_gap_rows.summary: experimental-widgets Capabilities send/read filters and ToDeviceEventFilter enable capability negotiation that can include to-device types such as io.element.call.encryption_keys. This is capability plumbing only—not a high-level encryption-key session API and not membership write parity.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Webview host, postMessage, actual membership events, key exchange runtime, UI.

additional_gap_rows.topic: MatrixRTC membership write + encryption-key session lifecycle
additional_gap_rows.summary: At this pin there is no stable high-level public MatrixRTC session API for membership writes (join/leave m.call.member state) or end-to-end encryption-key exchange lifecycle. Presence reads and experimental widget capability plumbing do not constitute that route. No compiling probe is claimed for a nonexistent high-level API.
additional_gap_rows.source_notes: has_active_room_call is read-only presence; capabilities.rs documents encryption_keys to-device capability strings used by the experimental widget machine, not a product session manager.
additional_gap_rows.remaining_work: Either product implementation via experimental widgets + raw/state sends with risk gate, or upstream high-level MatrixRTC session API.

preliminary_minimum_feature_recommendati.notes_on_e2e: If matrix-sdk-ui is always a direct dependency, e2e-encryption may already unify; still request e2e-encryption explicitly on matrix-sdk for clarity.

matrix-sdk/experimental-push-secrets.rationale: Not required for current product parity.

matrix-sdk/unstable-msc4274.rationale: Optional inline media galleries; not Phase 1 minimum.

matrix-sdk/experimental-search.rationale: Local index only; typed server search covers baseline without experimental gate.

matrix-sdk/experimental-element-recent-e.rationale: Not required for current product parity.

matrix-sdk-ui/unstable-msc3956.rationale: Optional encrypted extensible events UI support; not Phase 1 minimum.

matrix-sdk-ui/experimental-encrypted-sta.rationale: Not required for current product parity.

matrix-sdk/default.rationale: Request features explicitly; defaults pull automatic-room-key-forwarding + sqlite together.

matrix-sdk-ui/default.rationale: UI defaults are empty; still prefer default-features=false for explicitness.

matrix-sdk/sso-login.rationale: Manual SSO URL + callback works without local-server feature.

matrix-sdk/uniffi.rationale: Desktop embeds Rust directly; iOS FFI separate.

matrix-sdk-ui/uniffi.rationale: Desktop embeds Rust directly; iOS FFI separate.

server_typed_search_vs_experimental_sear.recommendation: Use typed server search (SC-071) for Phase 1; do not enable experimental-search for Phase 1 minimum.
server_typed_search_vs_experimental_sear.rationale: experimental-search is a separate local index with persistence implications and experimental status.

sqlite_recommendation.rationale: Plan requires native SQLite-backed stores; builder API stable and compile-probed. Runtime open still P0.5/P0.3d.

automatic_room_key_forwarding_recommenda.decision: do not enable for Phase 1 minimum
automatic_room_key_forwarding_recommenda.rationale: Not required for compile-time capability; requires explicit later security decision.

experimental_widgets_recommendation.decision: not in Phase 1 minimum feature set; keep as blocking call-track risk
experimental_widgets_recommendation.rationale: Pinned SDK demonstrates experimental widget/driver API shapes only—not call parity. Full membership write + key session remains no viable high-level public route.

evidence_limits: No homeserver contact, no store open, no secrets, no UI acceptance.
Does not write final P0.3 capability dossier (P0.3d).
Does not accept experimental APIs for production.
Element Call product parity remains unresolved blocking risk.
Full MatrixRTC membership write + encryption-key session lifecycle has no viable high-level public route at this pin.
p0_3d_and_later_remaining: Live Synapse two-client tests for typed search, receipts/unread, verification, recovery, devices.
UI acceptance for auth/SSO/OAuth, search, verification, recovery.
Call/widget end-to-end with experimental-widgets risk gate.
Final Section 5 dossier states after runtime evidence.
